comment: Machine form of SEMANTIC_WORKFLOW_PROGRAMS.md §3 — every workflow transition and what enforces it. hook = machine, cannot be ignored; exit-code = runtime-checked; prompt = model goodwill (the known failure surface; migrate rows upward one at a time). gate_runner pre-wave verifies hook rows are registered and present, exit-code rows exist, and reports the prompt-row count as the open migration surface. Keep rows aligned with settings.json and the hooks directory; a row here with no live file goes red at wave start.
